Lemma
[Evolution of the modified pinching quantity] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0277, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0278 1. Lemma 9.11\group necklike-points-in-finite-time-singularities

The quantity \[ F=(T-t)^\varepsilon rac{|\Rm |^2}{(R+ ho )^{2-\varepsilon }} \] satisfies a differential inequality of the form \[ rac{\partial }{\partial t}F\le \Delta F+ rac{2(1-\varepsilon )}{R+ ho }\langle abla F, abla R angle +H, \] with $H$ given by the source and decomposed into bad terms $B_1,B_2$ and good terms $G_1,G_2$.
